name: @pipeworx/mcp-federal-appeals

tools.name: federal_appeal_search
tools.description: Find US FEDERAL APPEALS by party name. Searches 2.2 million federal appellate dockets — the circuit courts and the Supreme Court — no API key. Returns case caption, docket number, court, filing and termination dates. Use for "has this case been appealed", "what is on appeal in the Ninth Circuit", and appellate history checks. For the resulting written OPINION and its full text, use the court-listener pack.

party.description: Party name or a distinctive part of it, e.g. "Oracle".

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

filed_before.description: Only cases filed on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: federal_appeal_recent
tools.description: List recent US federal appellate dockets, newest first, optionally limited to one circuit. No API key, no rate limit.

filed_after.description: Only cases filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-federal-appeals forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the federal-appeals pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
